$comment: The core suite's reviewed platform lists (scripts/platform-tests.ts; paths relative to packages/core). linuxKnownFailures: Linux product bugs the Linux shards skip until their owner fixes them; a listed file that starts passing fails CI, so the list only shrinks, and a new Linux failure fails its shard until it is fixed or reviewed here. linuxSkips: Linux files whose tests may skip, each with why. darwinGateAllowed: Linux files that name darwin near a test gate without gating on it.

test/auth/credential-migration-lock.test.cause: I-A: a process's start time reads null on Linux (the test wants epoch seconds, as from sysctl and ps on macOS)

test/cowork/peer-inbox-sqlite.test.ts.cause: a failing rename of the scrubbed copy reports runtime-state.db corrupt on Linux instead of leaving the raw copy

test/runtime-state/crash-matrix.test.ts.cause: repairRuntimeState doesn't restore the backup over a corrupt runtime-state.db (sidecars and all) on Linux

test/e2e/mid-turn-fold-e2e.test.ts.cause: a steer to a running session folds twice, and TaskStop's cleared steer never closes the stopped turn on Linux

test/e2e/per-call-tool-results-e2e.test..cause: a Write and a sleeping Bash in one round: the Bash's tool_result lands before the Write's on Linux

test/e2e/embedded-chat-dispatch-e2e.test.cause: a CODE and a DISPATCH session's embedded Bash result lacks the command's output on Linux

linuxSkips.src/clock/tests/shared-clock.test.ts: one live SNTP query against the public servers runs only with CLOVER_LIVE_TIME=1, on every OS
linuxSkips.src/links/tests/sidecar.test.ts: needs the built clover-link sidecar: the link job builds it and runs these on Linux, Windows and macOS
linuxSkips.test/agent/browser-gates.test.ts: holds no tests on any OS: its gate walk retired with the engine (Task 17); the capability's sequence is pinned in test/capabilities
linuxSkips.test/agent/mcp/oauth-doors.test.ts: one drift guard runs only beside the linked SDK source, on every OS
linuxSkips.test/cowork/guest-runtime.test.ts: one test needs the candidate SDK's confined fixture, on every OS
linuxSkips.test/cowork/guided-reader-adapter.test.t: one opt-in drift guard against the SDK source, on every OS
an opt-in integration run (its env), skipped on every OS by default
linuxSkips.test/fence/fence.test.ts: one test needs Win32 path semantics (a `..` after a real NTFS junction); it runs on the Windows tree job
linuxSkips.test/ipc/session-set-model-review.test.t: one live model-convergence case runs only with its env, on every OS
linuxSkips.test/runtime-sdk/embedded-live-path-prot: a live run with its env only, on every OS
one measurement needs the built runtime binary, on every OS
a soak, run on demand with its env, on every OS

darwinGateAllowed.test/lock.test.ts: "darwin" is classifyLockFailure's platform argument (the errno table per OS), not a gate
